question: What precedent demonstrates the enchanting power of reciting this text?
premises: Recitation of this text is the cause.
Even Nārada produced enchantment through it.
All moving and unmoving beings were deluded.
inference: By reciting this text, even Nārada enchanted all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: By reciting it, even Nārada deluded all that moves and does not move.
